devon_ml: Quick rundown — ran a KV-cache bench comparing H100 (us-west) vs A100 (eu-west). Workload: 70% short (<=64), 20% medium (65-512), 10% long (>512). Hot/cold split 8:1. Posting raw summary and a couple plots.

benchbot: ./run_kv_bench --model=gptx-7b --seqmix="70,20,10" --hotcold=8:1 --region=us-west --gpu=h100
results: p50=8ms p95=28ms p99=85ms throughput=5200 tok/s cache_hit=0.72 evictions/s=18 :bar_chart: <https://bench.internal/runs/2234567890>

sara_ng: nice — do you have per-seqlen hit rates? p99 by seqlen? :eyes:

devon_ml: per-seqlen numbers: short hit=0.92 p99=6ms; medium hit=0.64 p99=45ms; long hit=0.12 p99=220ms. Attached chart: <https://bench.internal/runs/2234567890/plots/seqlen-hit.png>

alex_k: curious what kernel was used for medium seqs — cuBLAS fused-attention or Triton custom? any quantization impact?

miguel_p: In eu-west/A100 bench we see p95 ~48ms, p99 ~110ms, overall hit 0.69. Kernel auto-switch landed improved medium seq latency by ~18% when using block-fused kernels. Quantized int8 increased throughput by ~30% but bumped p99 for long seqs due to decode overhead.

devon_ml: script we used:
```
./bench.py --model gptx-7b-qint8 --kernels=auto --kv-policy=prefetch:window=32,evict:threshold=0.2
```
Also tried evict threshold sweep: 0.1/0.2/0.4 -> hit 0.78/0.72/0.61, p99 overall 60/85/130ms respectively.

sara_ng: suggests we need an SLO guidance doc: for dedicated capacity how to size pool for 95% short request mix.

liam_ops: for dedicated sizing: rule-of-thumb = steady throughput / (per-gpu throughput * target utilization). For H100 we measured ~6k tok/s under these settings so plan 1.2x for buffer. FYI canary deploy windows need 15m. :memo:

alex_k: kernel fallback note: set kernel_policy = prefer_low_latency, fallback_to_high_throughput. That reduced p99 spikes during bursts in our tests.

miguel_p: also watch KV paging peaks — when cold tail >6% we saw async spill causing 50-200ms flares. Prefetch window >24 helped but increased memory pressure.

devon_ml: next steps: 1) run eviction algo comparison (LRU vs seg-LRU vs cost-aware) on same seqmix, 2) capture flamegraphs for p99 long requests, 3) propose defaults for dedicated customers. @liam_ops can we allocate a small eu-west A100 pool for 3 hours tomorrow? :calendar:

liam_ops: yep, reserving 4xA100 for 3h @ 09:00 UTC tomorrow. @benchbot plz schedule.

benchbot: scheduled reservation id r-3342 for 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC :white_check_mark:

devon_ml: thanks — one thing: anyone seen regression in quality with qint8 on long sequences? saw mild increase in hallucination rate in eval set.

miguel_p: saw some tokenization misalignments with qint8 for long contexts — adding mixed-precision decode check helps. open a quick eval PR? :wrench:

sara_ng: I can run the eval on the privacy prompt set and report back by EOD.
